context: Sho and Hina eat persimmons in the garden.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Sho, try this persimmon — it's really sweet.
lines.style: Bright, genuine offer. Quick warm opening. Slight lift on 「甘い」 to show off the sweetness. Childish earnestness — wanting him to taste what she's found. No rush, just pure sharing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft genuine surprise. Small sharp intake on 「うわあ」, then immediate warmth. Quiet appreciation — not performed for her, but real. A six-year-old tasting something that tastes the way autumn should.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: It's persimmon season in autumn, you know.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly dreamy. Slower pace than before. An eight-year-old noticing the rhythm of seasons. Warm certainty — like she's sharing something she's just understood. Soft trailing-off, pleased with the observation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Eating together like this — it's fun.
lines.style: Soft, genuine reflection. Small voice, total sincerity. Not looking for agreement, just noticing aloud. The comfort of being together. Quiet warmth holding the whole thing.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I want to eat pears again too.
lines.style: Light, anticipatory. A slight lift looking forward. Childish want without whining. The pleasure of imagining the next season's taste. Warm, open, still in the moment but already dreaming ahead a little.
